           GUAREA TRICHILOIDES

         Ballwood

        (GUAREA)


Eye symptoms have been verified. Chemosis and pterygium have been cured
        with it. Lupus of an ochre-red color.



Eyes.--  Conjunctiva inflamed, swollen. Tearing pain in
        eyeballs; tension, forced-out feeling. Objects appear gray, upside down. Eye symptoms
        alternate with diminished hearing. Epiphora.



Head.--  Sensation as if brain were falling forwards; as from a
        blow on head.



Respiratory.--  Cough with sweat, pain and tightness of chest;
        larynx irritated.



Dose.--  Tincture.
